name: Acceptance suite-3 test 91c - cross-account PassRole target coexisting with an account-wildcard role ARN
note: IAM-1005 near-miss (F1 regression guard, case B2): iam:PassRole to a FOREIGN-account role (999900001111) alongside an account-WILDCARD role ARN (arn:aws:iam::*:role/Any), analyzed with subject account 123456789012. The account-wildcard ARN spans every account INCLUDING the subject's own (123456789012), so a same-account pass to EC2 is viable and critical. The account-mismatch downgrade must NOT fire: severity stays critical, no accountMismatch metadata.
